game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Mc-Mc
quote: The relationship between Jason and Lucia to me was a partner in crime relationship and the game would *allow* you to pursue a romantic one if you wanted. The game forcing you to maintain a positive romantic relationship kills the replay-ability of the story for me. The bugs are also a huge issue with the amount of money and development time this game has had to polish the finished product. I should not be clipping through ceilings, phasing through doors, restart a mission because nothing is being dropped, or get launched by a tree to the other side of the island. Ok, the last one was funny, but only if I’m not in the middle of a mission or get caused to die, dropping all my **** cop AI is a cool touch, but it can all be avoided by, as oversimplified says, running away.I am a few chapters in, I will still put hours into this game, but for the time and money put into it, GTA6 really underperformed in my eyes and truly lost GOTY.
